references.text: Psalm 22:7-8 describes a similar situation where people mock and shake their heads at the suffering one, which mirrors the event in Matthew 27:39.
In Psalm 109:25 there is also mention of people shaking their heads, an action that can be seen as a form of mockery, similar to what happens in Matthew 27:39.
Isaiah 53:3 describes how the servant is despised and rejected by men, which can be connected to how Jesus is treated in Matthew 27:39.
The entire passage in Matthew 27:39-44 gives a detailed description of mockery and scorn toward Jesus, where verse 39 sets the scene.
